name: Microsoft Teams
shortInfo: Microsoft Teams is a proprietary business communication platform
brief: The Microsoft Teams allows communities, groups, or teams to contribute in a shared workspace where messages and digital content on a specific topic are shared.
about:
The Microsoft Teams Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Microsoft Teams in an automated manner.

Check more about Microsoft Teams api documentation [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/channel-post-messages?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http).
availableSync:
[Message](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/microsoft-teams/syncs/message.html)[](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/microsoft-teams/syncs/message.html)  
This sync can be used to request and retrieve data from a user specified data warehouse to a Microsoft Teams channel.
